public_commands.LASEROUT: The sole conversion command. Creates grouped open zero-width LWPOLYLINE glyphs and one two-stroke upward arrow.
public_commands.LASERFONT: Selects the LaserFont3 display style and sets the default text height to 5.

mtext_reproduction.fixture_dependency_note: The first ObjectDBX copy retained the destination Standard font and was restored in the private unsaved copy to its independently verified source LaserFont3 style. The second copied style already matched. Both fixtures resolved the freshly compiled arrow font from the test search path.
mtext_reproduction.narrow_width_case: The second actual MTEXT has a narrow reference width but its uninterrupted string resolves natively to one TEXT line. No multiline or wrap patch was required.

undo_verification.tested: LASEROUT followed by one U restores both actual MTEXT copies and all four rotated v1/v2/v3 TEXT cases, removing every output path and the conversion group.
undo_verification.harness_configuration: Automatic command/script Undo grouping disabled only in each isolated test profile.

prior_release_evidence_not_rerun.scope_note: Historical corner-key release evidence only; the current arrow geometry is covered by the new 68-check suite and compiled-font decoding.

limitations: This suite does not verify GUI APPLOAD, the active drawing or the installed arrow candidate; those require separate installation/live proof.
Native MTEXT proof covers the two reproduced plain single-line top-left cases. Inline formatting, wrapping, columns and unsupported style overrides remain guarded.
Cancellation, save/reopen, internal exact-curve helpers and arbitrary UCS transforms were not rerun for this arrow candidate.
CAM import, physical cutting, kerf, piercing and human orientation recognition were not tested.
Label geometry does not establish the true outside face of a fabricated assembly.

orientation_symbol.qualification: The arrow is symmetric by itself. Its before-ID position and up direction are read with the complete ID. It is a text-reading cue, not an installation UP instruction.
